title: Rob McConnell & The Boss Brass The Brass Is Back CD 1991 Concord Jazz
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Rob McConnell & The Boss Brass - The Brass Is Back
(Concord Jazz CCD-4458, 1991). UPC 013431445821. Made in USA.
Recorded and remixed at Manta Sound Studios, Toronto, January 28-29,
1991. Executive producer Carl E. Jefferson; produced by Phil Sheridan.

All arrangements by Rob McConnell except "Who Asked," arranged by
Rick Wilkins. Featuring Moe Koffman, Ed Bickert, Don Thompson,
Guido Basso, Terry Clarke and Steve Wallace.

1. Strollin' (7:01)
2. All The Things You Are (11:06)
3. Love Of My Life (7:08)
4. Who Asked (9:34)
5. Slow Grind (7:25)
6. Winter In Winnipeg (7:17)
7. Days Gone By (6:18)
8. Them There Eyes (8:13)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
